messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 24(3)

Article 24 Amendment of Directive 95/16/EC. 3. This Directive shall not apply to: — lifting appliances whose speed is not greater than 0,15 m/s, — construction site hoists, — cableways, including funicular railways, — lifts specially designed and constructed for military or police purposes, — lifting appliances from which work can be carried out, — mine winding gear, — lifting appliances intended for lifting performers during artistic performances, — lifting appliances fitted in means of transport, — lifting appliances connected to machinery and intended exclusively for access to workstations including maintenance and inspection points on the machinery, — rack and pinion trains, — escalators and mechanical walkways.’;
